# 1b: downloads core

## Read first

- [architecture.md](../architecture.md) sections Inside shelf, Source interfaces, Downloads, Events and HTTP API; [data-model.md](../data-model.md); [provenance.md](../provenance.md).
- proxier: `internal/platform/jobs/*.go` and `jobstest`, `internal/platform/migrations/00003_jobs.sql`, `internal/platform/backup/backup.go`, `jobStream` in `internal/platform/pages/jobs.go`, and the `EventSource` side in `internal/platform/ui/static/js/proxier.js`.
- The As built section of [1a](1a.md).

## Done when

- The trimmed jobs platform runs the queues `qobuz`, `applemusic`, `library` and `system`, and the backup job runs daily at 03:30 in `SHELF_TIMEZONE`, keeping 14 copies.
- `internal/source` has the types and interfaces, and the registry serves `/api/sources`.
- The `fakesource` module serves canned albums, tracks, an artist and a playlist, and fake downloads that write small files into `/music/fake`.
- The `downloads` module has its tables, `Service`, the job type with its four steps, the provenance writer, the notifier port, and parent and child downloads.
- The `catalog` module serves `/api/search`, `/api/resolve` and `/api/items` over every registered source.
- `/api/downloads`, `/api/downloads/{id}/log` and `/api/events` work against the fake source.
- `shelf manage download <url> [--format F] [--force]` queues a download with origin `cli`.
- Every checklist line has its test.

## Decisions

| Topic | Decision | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Jobs | Copy proxier's `jobs` and remove the vault with `Run.Secret`, `DeleteSecret` and the `secrets` column, the settings overrides, the events catalog and notify. An actor becomes a plain string. Keep `Type`, `Step`, `Request`, `Enqueue`, `EnqueueNow`, `Cancel`, `Retry`, `Reap`, `Watch`, the logger with redaction, the queries, schedules, retention, `Permanent` and `Defer`. | The tested platform without what shelf doesn't use. |
| Queues | `qobuz` 1, `applemusic` 1, `library` 1, `system` 1. The fake source uses `system`. | One download per source at a time, as the services expect. |
| Payload and keys | Payload `{"download_id": n}`. Resource key `item:<source>:<kind>:<id>`. `created_by` is `web`, `telegram:<user id>`, `cli`, `schedule:<name>` or `job:<id>`. | Two downloads of one item never run at once. |
| Steps | `resolve`, `fetch`, `finish`, `notify`, as in architecture.md. `fetch` relies on the source skipping complete files, so it can run again after a restart. | Resume after a restart. |
| Status | The download's status follows its job: `queued`, then `running`, then `done`, `partial` or `failed` from the result, or `canceled`. An interrupted job's download stays `running` and resumes. | One status per download. |
| Progress | `download_tracks` and the counts are written at most once a second per download; the hub gets every change. | SQLite writes stay cheap and the UI stays live. |
| Provenance | `downloads/provenance.go` renders a block from the download, its tracks and the `DownloadResult`, and appends it to `<folder>/shelf.txt` unless a block with the same first line exists. Mode 0644. | provenance.md. |
| Notifier | `type Notifier interface { Notify(ctx context.Context, d Download) error }`, called by the `notify` step when `origin` is `telegram` and `notified` is 0. A no-op until 1f wires the bot. | The last message edit happens once. |
| Hub | `hub.Publish(topic string, v any)` and `hub.Subscribe(topics ...string) (<-chan Event, func())`. Slow subscribers drop events instead of blocking publishers. | The UI reloads on reconnect, so a dropped event costs nothing. |
| Event stream | `/api/events` sets `Content-Type: text/event-stream`, `Cache-Control: no-store`, `X-Accel-Buffering: no`, and sends `: keepalive` every 15 seconds. | The gateway buffers and closes idle connections. |
| Log stream | `/api/downloads/{id}/log` sends the job's log lines with their row IDs as event IDs and resumes after `Last-Event-ID`. | proxier's `jobStream`. |
| Fake source | ID `fake`. Item IDs ending in `-fail` fail their second track; `-slow` sleeps 200 ms per track; `-big` has 40 tracks. Search filters its canned list by the query. | Tests and UI work need predictable cases. |
| JSON | Downloads are answered as `{"id", "parent_id", "source", "kind", "item_id", "url", "format", "title", "artist", "cover_url", "status", "error", "tracks_total", "tracks_done", "tracks_failed", "bytes", "folder", "origin", "created_at", "started_at", "finished_at"}`. The detail adds `tracks`, `children` and `provenance_path`. | One shape for the UI and the bot. |

## Tables

Platform migration `00001_jobs.sql`: proxier's `jobs`, `job_steps`, `job_log_lines` and `schedules`, without the `secrets` column and `event_cursors`.

Downloads migration `00001_downloads.sql`: the three tables in [data-model.md](../data-model.md).

## Go signatures

```go
// internal/modules/downloads
type QueueRequest struct {
    Ref       source.Ref // or URL
    URL       string
    Format    string // empty: the source's default
    Force     bool
    Origin    string // "web", "telegram", "cli"
    OriginRef OriginRef
}

func (s *Service) Queue(ctx context.Context, r QueueRequest) (Download, error)
func (s *Service) Get(ctx context.Context, id int64) (Detail, error)
func (s *Service) List(ctx context.Context, f Filter) ([]Download, error)
func (s *Service) Cancel(ctx context.Context, id int64, by string) error
func (s *Service) Retry(ctx context.Context, id int64, by string) (Download, error)
func (s *Service) SetNotifier(n Notifier)

var (
    ErrUnknownLink   = errors.New("downloads: link not from a known source")
    ErrUnknownSource = errors.New("downloads: unknown or disabled source")
    ErrNotRetryable  = errors.New("downloads: only failed, partial or canceled downloads can be retried")
)
```

## Routes

As in [architecture.md](../architecture.md), except `/api/library/*`, which comes in 1f, and `/api/applemusic/*`, which comes in 1e. `ErrUnknownLink` and `ErrUnknownSource` answer 422, `ErrNotRetryable` 409.

## Checklist

| Edge case | Test |
| --- | --- |
| A ref creates a download and a job on its source's queue | `TestQueueByRef` |
| A link goes through the sources' `ParseLink` | `TestQueueByLink` |
| A link no source knows answers 422 | `TestQueueUnknownLink` |
| An unknown or disabled source answers 422 | `TestQueueUnknownSource` |
| An item in `downloaded_items` gives a `skipped` download | `TestQueueSkipsDownloaded` |
| `force` downloads it again | `TestQueueForceDownloadsAgain` |
| Two downloads of one item run one after the other | `TestSameItemRunsOneAtATime` |
| Downloads from two sources run at the same time | `TestSourcesRunInParallel` |
| Progress reaches SQLite at most once a second and the hub every time | `TestProgressThrottled` |
| A `done` download writes `downloaded_items` and `shelf.txt` | `TestFinishDone` |
| A `partial` download writes `shelf.txt` and no `downloaded_items` row | `TestFinishPartial` |
| A failed download with no files writes neither | `TestFinishFailedWithoutFiles` |
| `shelf.txt` gets a second block for another download | `TestProvenanceAppends` |
| `shelf.txt` gets no second block for the same download | `TestProvenanceSkipsSameDownload` |
| Without `SHELF_PUBLIC_URL` the Shelf link line is left out | `TestProvenanceWithoutPublicURL` |
| Canceling a queued download never runs it | `TestCancelQueued` |
| Canceling a running download stops its context | `TestCancelRunning` |
| Retry of a failed download queues a new job and keeps the old log | `TestRetryFailed` |
| Retry of a done download answers 409 | `TestRetryDoneRefused` |
| A restart during `fetch` resumes from `fetch` and skips finished files | `TestResumeAfterRestart` |
| An artist expands into one child download per album | `TestArtistExpands` |
| A parent's status and counts follow its children | `TestParentFollowsChildren` |
| An artist with no albums ends `done` with "nothing to download" | `TestArtistWithoutAlbums` |
| `notify` calls the notifier once, also after a restart | `TestNotifyOnce` |
| `/api/events` streams download events with keepalives and the buffering header | `TestEventsStream` |
| The log stream resumes after `Last-Event-ID` | `TestLogStreamResumes` |
| `/api/sources` lists each source's capabilities and formats | `TestSourcesCapabilities` |
| `/api/search` with an unsupported type answers 400 | `TestSearchBadType` |
| `/api/items` marks each entry's download status | `TestItemsCarryStatus` |
| The backup writes a copy and keeps 14 | `TestBackupKeeps14` |
| `manage download` queues with origin `cli` | `TestManageDownload` |
